public.title: Studily: Free Student Planner, Flashcards & Study Timer
public.description: Your whole semester on one screen: class schedule, assignments and exams, grade tracking, spaced-repetition flashcards, a Pomodoro study timer and study friends. Free.

public.title: About Studily: The All-in-One Student Planner
public.description: Studily is a free academic planner built by a student: weekly schedules, deadlines and grades, flashcards, Pomodoro study sessions and classmates in one app.

public.title: Create Your Free Studily Account
public.description: Sign up free and put your class schedule, assignments, grades, flashcards and study timer in one place. No card, no trial.

public.title: Log In to Studily
public.description: Log in to Studily to see your schedule, upcoming deadlines, flashcards and study sessions.

public.title: Free Pomodoro Timer for Studying · Studily
public.description: A free online Pomodoro timer for studying: 25-minute focus sprints and short breaks, Long and Deep presets, custom lengths, alarm sounds and fullscreen. No sign-up needed.

public.title: Grade Calculator: What Do I Need on My Final? · Studily
public.description: Add sections like assignments, midterms and your final exam with their weights, enter marks like 18/20 or 85%, and see exactly what you need on the final. Free.

public.title: Interactive Periodic Table of Elements · Studily
public.description: Search all 118 elements by name, symbol or number and tap any element for its atomic mass, electron configuration, electronegativity, melting and boiling points and density. Free.

public.title: Install Studily on iPhone, Android or Desktop
public.description: Add Studily to your home screen in a few taps. It opens full-screen like a native app and sends reminders before classes and deadlines.

public.title: Studily Changelog: What's New
public.description: Every feature and fix added to Studily, newest first: flashcard study modes, study sessions and badges, course outline import and more.

public.title: Studily Support: Report a Bug or Share an Idea
public.description: Found a bug or have an idea? Studily is in beta, and every report shapes what gets fixed and built next.

public.title: Terms of Service · Studily
public.description: The terms for using Studily: who can use it, acceptable use, warnings and bans, and how the service works.

public.title: Privacy Policy · Studily
public.description: What Studily collects, how it's used and where it's stored. Your data is never sold, and Studily uses no analytics or advertising trackers.
